title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x1
episodes_data.description: Ash begins his journey in Johto, a largely unexplored region said to be thickly populated with Pokémon entirely new to him and his friends.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x2
episodes_data.description: In a Pokémon battle, Ash soundly defeats an ambitious young Trainer, who runs away dejectedly.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x3
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends discover a forest where invading Pinsir are causing heavy deforestation.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x4
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends stumble into a small valley where Donphan are used to harvest precious stones.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x5
episodes_data.description: Who would be foolish enough to brave a thick forest in the dead of night without a Hoothoot guide? Certainly not Ash Ketchum...

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x6
episodes_data.description: Our heroes must help prepare an insecure Bellossom dance troupe for their upcoming exhibition.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x7
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends reach a new town and hear of three mysterious robbers apparently mimicking the crimes of a legendary master thief.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x8
episodes_data.description: With pet food prepared by a French chef, rooms of WalkMaster exercise equipment and closets stocked with the latest in Pokémon fashion, life couldn't be much better for a Palm Hills Snubbull.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x9
episodes_data.description: Brock saves a lost and frightened Stantler fawn and carefully nurses it back to health before releasing it.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x10
episodes_data.description: Ash encounters a wild Chikorita and engages it in battle, thinking to add it to his team.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x11
episodes_data.description: Professor Oak's errand—to deliver the mysterious GS Ball to a Poké Ball expert—is interrupted when a Quagsire with a penchant for spherical objects steals the GS ball for use in a nocturnal ritual.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x12
episodes_data.description: When Team Rocket attacks Ash and his friends, a brave young Trainer and her flock of Ledyba come to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x13
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket can't believe their luck when the Blissey employed in a Pokémon Center willingly gives them the cente's entire food supply.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x14
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are recruited as guest instructors at a youth Pokémon Academy.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x15
episodes_data.description: With Pikachu's help, Ash is confident that winning the Zephyr badge will be a breeze.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x16
episodes_data.description: Cute and cuddly is one thing, but a bawling Marill is too much even for Misty.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x17
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket's most recent super vehicle, the Arbotank, is their ticket to world domination.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x18
episodes_data.description: When Ash hears of the nearby Charicific Valley, he is sure a quick trip would be just the thing to reignite his Charizard's flagging spirits.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x19
episodes_data.description: The annual Sunflora contest is only a day away and yet our hero's new friend and Sunflora Trainer is unable to convince her star Pokémon to compete.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x20
episodes_data.description: A severe case of rivalry between Pikachu and Chikorita calls for therapy sessions with Nurse Joy.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x21
episodes_data.description: Our heroes chance upon a Hoppip—the fluffy "Cottonweed" Pokémon that is able to drift for miles on a passing wind.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x22
episodes_data.description: When Ash and friends wander into town, they bring with them a challenge that threatens to be Gligarman's last—Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x23
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket comes in sheep's clothing to relieve a kind Poké-shepherd of her Mareep flock.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x24
episodes_data.description: When the most promising trainee at a Pokémon dojo abandons battle altogether, it's up to Ash and friends to convince him that battling is more than just a matter of probability.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x25
episodes_data.description: With Charizard gone and no fire Pokémon to call his own, Ash is overjoyed to come across a Cyndaquil in the wild.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x26
episodes_data.description: Ash carelessly makes enemies of the Slowpoke-worshipping residents of a town.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x27
episodes_data.description: Ash delivers the mysterious GS Ball to a renowned Pokémon expert, but Team Rocket wreaks trouble when they attempt to harvest the Apricorns essential to local Poké Ball production.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x28
episodes_data.description: When Ash reaches the Hive Gym, he has just the Pokémon to challenge the Gym Leader's Bug Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x29
episodes_data.description: An inexperienced young Trainer mistakenly scares off his own Farfetch'd.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x30
episodes_data.description: At the Pokémon Swap Meet, our heroes befriend a young Pokémon trainer who's having difficulties finding a trading partner willing to accept his Wobbuffet. When Jessie inadvertently deposits her Poké Ball across from his in the exchanger, this young trainer gets more than he had bargained for.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x31
episodes_data.description: Rocket attempts to steal all the water Pokémon from the annual Fire and Rescue Grand Prix.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x32
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends enthusiastically volunteer to watch over a troubled trainer's school of Wooper.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x33
episodes_data.description: While Ash and friends deliberate on how to pass through a tunnel replete with Onix, two wandering Pokémon arrive on the scene together.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x34
episodes_data.description: Investigating a string of mysterious thefts, our heroes discover a pack of Houndour, struggling to survive in the wild.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x35
episodes_data.description: Ash and Misty's friendly rivalry is tested when they both try to capture a Totodile at the same time. Unable to determine whose Poké Ball had captured the wild Pokémon, the two must battle it out to determine the Totodile's new master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x36
episodes_data.description: When Ash and friends hear of a virtually undefeatable trainer operating nearby, they seek her out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x37
episodes_data.description: Ash's Totodile falls head over tail for a passing Azumarill, but is still unsuccessful in having its feelings requited when Team Rocket kidnap the Pokémon before Totodile's eyes.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x38
episodes_data.description: Ash has his sights set on a rare and brightly-colored Noctowl.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x39
episodes_data.description: When an Ursaring attack leaves Team Rocket and our heroes in compromising positions, compromise they do, members of each team being paired with members of the other.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x40
episodes_data.description: Our heroes come to a town whose residents all raise Psychic Pokémon to repel the Ghost Pokémon that lurk nearby

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 3 The Johto Journeys 3x41
episodes_data.description: A Pokémon Fortune Telling boom turns out to be a Team Rocket plot to steal Pokémon from local trainers.
